808: export function getStats(cardId, upgraded = false) {
809:   const def = CARDS[cardId];
810:   if (!def) throw new Error('Unknown card ' + cardId);
811:   const s = {
812:     dmg: def.dmg || 0, block: def.block || 0, heal: def.heal || 0, draw: def.draw || 0,
813:     energy: def.energy || 0, strength: def.strength || 0, hits: def.hits || 1,
814:     gold: def.gold || 0, cost: def.cost || 0, special: def.special || null,
815:     statuses: { ...(def.statuses || {}) }
816:   };
817:   if (upgraded && def.up) {
818:     for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(def.up)) {
819:       if (k === 'special') s.special = v;
820:       else if (k === 'cost') s.cost = Math.max(0, s.cost + v);
821:       else if (['dmg','block','heal','draw','energy','strength','hits','gold'].includes(k)) s[k] += v;
822:       else s.statuses[k] = (s.statuses[k] || 0) + v;
823:     }
824:   }
825:   return s;
826: }
